title: Flash SegaSaturn Vol. 26
native_title: フラッシュ・セガサターン Ｖｏｌ．２６
overview:
Flash SegaSaturn Vol. 26 is a free Japanese demo disc from Sega that collects trial versions and previews of Saturn games.

Playable demos:
- Sakura Taisen 2: Kimi, Shinitamou Koto Nakare
- Dungeon Master Nexus
- Cross Tantei Monogatari: Motsureta Nanatsu no Labyrinth
- Savaki

Non-playable previews:
- The House of the Dead
- Dragon Force II: Kami Sarishi Daichi ni
- Ayakashi Ninden Kunoichiban Plus
- The King of Fighters '97
- Waku Waku Puyo Puyo Dungeon
- Tokimeki Memorial Drama Series Vol. 2: Irodori no Love Song

The disc also carries a text file with information about Sakura Taisen 2.
